selection: Scalar/table Sqrt, Exp, Ln, Log, Power, Int, Trunc and trigonometry. Expected values are decoded only from upstream literal oracles. Float values opt into the pinned BaseRunner.NumberCompare rule (absolute <1e-5 or relative <1e-14); existing corpus cases keep exact matching. Compiler-message cases and the undocumented Canvas Trunc digits overload are excluded. Formula-level error handling is enabled; legacy blank-on-invalid-math behavior is not simulated.
